title: Campaign Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often campaign metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on campaign metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out how often your campaign metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
